interpret_schematic: interpret a natural language command into Minecraft schematic blocks with block IDs and tags
interpret_fill_schematic: interpret a fill command to generate blocks that fill a hole mold with specified attributes
interpret_shape_schematic: interpret a shape command to generate schematic blocks for named shapes like cube or pyramid
interpret_named_schematic: interpret a named schematic command to look up and return stored schematic blocks from memory
interpret_mob_schematic: interpret a mob spawn command to resolve schematic memory IDs for spawning entities
